title: Activation-Adjacent Layer Normalization: Effects on Approximation Power
abstract: arXiv:2610.21527v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Layer normalization (LN) and root mean square normalization (RMSNorm) depend on their inputs and remain nonlinear at inference. Inserting either next to an activation may therefore change the function a network represents. We study when shallow activation-normalized (AN) and preactivation-normalized (PN) networks can approximate a prescribed width-$N$ one-hidden-layer MLP. Viewing RMSNorm as input-dependent scaling, we use width augmentation to locally linearize normalization on compact feature sets. For AN networks, an unbounded activation range allows width $N+1$, while every continuous nonconstant activation admits width $N+r$ with error $O_f(r^{-1})$. For PN networks, affine parameters or, without them, degree-one positive homogeneity recover width $N+1$; general continuous activations admit width $N+r$ with error tending to zero. The corresponding LN constructions use centered coordinate pairs, yielding widths $N+2$ and $N+2r$, resp

translated_title: 激活函数邻接层归一化：对逼近能力的影响
translated_abstract: 层归一化（LN）和均方根归一化（RMSNorm）依赖于其输入，在推理阶段仍保持非线性。因此，将它们插入激活函数旁边可能会改变网络所表示的函数。我们研究了浅层激活后归一化（AN）网络和激活前归一化（PN）网络在何种条件下能够逼近一个给定的宽度为 N 的单隐层多层感知机（MLP）。将 RMSNorm 视为依赖于输入的缩放操作，我们利用宽度增广技术在紧致特征集上对归一化进行局部线性化。对于 AN 网络，激活函数取值范围无界时可实现宽度 N+1；而对于任意连续非常值激活函数，宽度 N+r 即可，其误差为 O_f(r^{-1})。对于 PN 网络，仿射参数（或在无仿射参数情况下的一阶正齐次性）可恢复宽度 N+1；一般连续激活函数则可实现宽度 N+r 且误差趋于零。相应的 LN 构造使用中心化坐标对，分别得到宽度 N+2 和 N+2r。
tldr: 本文通过宽度增广与归一化的局部线性化技术，精确刻画了激活后归一化（AN）和激活前归一化（PN）网络在仅需常数级额外宽度的情况下逼近任意给定宽度 MLP 的条件与误差界。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes when activation-normalized (AN) and preactivation-normalized (PN) networks can approximate any prescribed width-N MLP using only a constant width overhead, via width augmentation and local linearization of normalization.
